funny_or_cringe_reel.focus: A recognisable home, shopping or family situation connected to furniture.
funny_or_cringe_reel.structure: Immediate setup, exaggerated reaction, quick product or store payoff, simple CTA.
rules: Keep the joke connected to the actual footage.
Use cringe intentionally through performance, not insulting copy.
Do not portray false pricing, staff conflict or customer deception as real.
Avoid jokes about debt, poverty, body size, marriage pressure or disability.
Keep the caption shorter when the reel contains the full joke.

hype_product_reel.focus: One product feature, transformation or offer presented with energy.
hype_product_reel.structure: Bold hook, visible feature, confirmed price or enquiry CTA.
rules: Use only visible or supplied product features.
Do not call a product viral, best-selling or number one without evidence.
Do not invent price, discount, material, size, load capacity or warranty.
Use fast, punchy lines without hiding conditions.

product_showcase.focus: The exact furniture item, its visible function and suitable room use.
rules: Do not infer solid wood, engineered wood, metal grade, foam density or fabric type from appearance.
Demonstrate moving parts accurately.
Do not promise customisation unless confirmed.

before_after_or_room_upgrade.focus: The real visual change in a room or storage setup.
rules: Use the same real space when presenting before and after.
Do not digitally enlarge rooms or remove permanent structures.
Do not claim interior-design service unless included.
State product details separately from styling suggestions.

offer_or_emi.focus: Exact product, price, upfront amount, EMI or promotion and purchase action.
rules: Do not publish zero down payment or ₹500 down payment from an older reel without current confirmation.
Do not say no-cost EMI unless explicitly confirmed.
Show eligibility and fees clearly.
Use exact dates for limited offers.

informational.focus: One useful furniture buying, space or maintenance point based on approved product information.
rules: Do not provide safety claims without specifications.
Use exact care instructions from the supplier.
Separate general room suggestions from product guarantees.

customer_review.status: Use only with an actual approved review.
rules: Do not invent buyer names, delivery speed, product life or ratings.
Keep quotes faithful.
Do not reveal order value or address without permission.

furniture_description_framework.rule: Describe the visible function first, then add only confirmed commercial and technical details.
